description: Taxonomy of problem categories and structural constraints for evaluating feasibility of student-typed project ideas.

categories.name: Long-Horizon Natural Disaster / Earthquake Prediction
failing_factors: Data availability: no public dataset exists with sufficient underground geological sensor granularity or verifiable precursors.
Research complexity: long-horizon seismic prediction remains unsolved fundamental geophysics/PhD-level research, exceeding undergraduate capstone scope.
Timeline constraint: validating statistical significance against low-frequency seismic events requires years of longitudinal data.

scoped_down_alternative.title: Seismic Sensor Telemetry Anomaly Detection & Micro-Tremor Triage
scoped_down_alternative.description: Short-horizon (under 60-second) P-wave seismic threshold detection and localized alert broadcasting using public USGS accelerometer streams.

categories.name: Autonomous Clinical Diagnosis & Prescription Recommendation
failing_factors: Regulatory lockout: autonomous diagnostic prescriptions require clinical trials, IRB approval, and FDA/CE software-as-medical-device clearance.
Liability & safety risk: black-box medical treatment recommendations pose critical patient safety failure risks without licensed physician oversight.
Data availability: longitudinal patient pharmacology outcome datasets are restricted under HIPAA with no open public equivalent.

scoped_down_alternative.title: Clinical Radiograph Pathology Decision-Support Assistant with Grad-CAM
scoped_down_alternative.description: Secondary triage assistant highlighting thoracic abnormalities on anonymized NIH/MIMIC chest X-rays to expedite radiologist review.

categories.name: Real-Time High-Frequency Trading & Arbitrage Engine
failing_factors: Data availability: sub-millisecond Level-3 market order book feeds require expensive proprietary Bloomberg/Reuters institutional subscriptions.
Hardware infrastructure: true HFT requires colocation server racks inside exchange data centers and specialized FPGA execution circuits.
Efficient market hypothesis: simple statistical models fail against institutional market makers, resulting in rapid capital liquidation.

scoped_down_alternative.title: Temporal Graph Anti-Money Laundering & Synthetic Fraud Ring Detector
scoped_down_alternative.description: Analyze transaction graphs on public Kaggle/IEEE financial datasets to identify multi-hop smurfing and laundering rings.

categories.name: Frontier Foundation Model Training from Scratch
keywords: create rival to chatgpt from scratch
failing_factors: Compute feasibility: pretraining foundational language models requires multimillion-dollar GPU clusters (thousands of H100s) and months of compute.
Data scale: curating and filtering multi-terabyte web corpora requires distributed data engineering infrastructure beyond university laboratories.
Budget constraints: power and cloud egress costs far exceed undergraduate capstone resources.

scoped_down_alternative.title: Domain-Specific Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (QLoRA) & RAG Assistant
scoped_down_alternative.description: Fine-tune an open-weights 7B/8B model using QLoRA with localized retrieval-augmented generation on a single consumer GPU.

categories.name: Commercial Satellite De-Orbit & Orbital Collision Interception
failing_factors: Data availability: live radar telemetry tracking classified space objects is restricted under national security (ITAR) regulations.
Verification constraint: impossible to deploy or empirically validate spacecraft maneuvers in physical space during a university semester.
Physics complexity: multi-body gravitational perturbation and orbital decay modeling requires specialized aerospace flight software.

scoped_down_alternative.title: Physics-Engine Orbital Debris Conjunction Warning Simulation
scoped_down_alternative.description: Simulate low-Earth orbit two-line element (TLE) satellite catalog ephemerides using SGP4 propagators to flag close conjunction passes.
